run_contextual_bandits_experiment: run an encrypted contextual bandits learning experiment on MNIST using the launcher with argparse cli
run_multiprocess_bandits: run the contextual bandits example in multiprocess mode with a specified world size
load_mnist_data_with_pca: load and preprocess MNIST dataset with optional PCA dimensionality reduction and k-means clustering rewards
build_bandit_learner: build an epsilon greedy or linucb learner with encrypted or plaintext backend and monitoring closures
visualize_learning_curve: visualize cumulative reward learning curves over time using visdom for contextual bandits
